text:
Priya: Ugh — just rode through a river on Valencia. Hoodie is officially part-sponge. Anyone else seeing the 22 bus stuck?
Alex: Yup. 22 stalled at 16th/Valencia, traffic backed up. Ferry and Caltrain look fine from status page. :umbrella: :sweat_smile:
Sam: BART reporting signal delays inbound 10–15m. Avoid Embarcadero if you can.
Noah: @Priya there’s a towel stash in the front lobby closet next to the lost-and-found. Help yourself. :handshake:
Priya: Thank you!! Heading to office anyway — hoping to dry out before standup. Coffee bribe if anyone spots a dryer machine? :coffee:
Marta: I have a tiny travel umbrella in my bike basket. Dropping it by 3rd floor — ping me when you get here. :rain_cloud:
CommuteBot: Caltrain: On time. BART: 10-15 min delays due to signal problem near Montgomery. Muni 22: Major slowdowns between 14th St and 20th St. (auto status snapshot)
Lina: Quick poll — who’s heading to the office now? React with :house: if yes, :house_with_garden: if maybe, :computer: if remote today.
Alex: :house:
Sam: :computer: (stuck on a delayed BART, working from phone)
Priya: :house_with_garden: arriving but soggy. Might need that towel and a spare hoodie :sweat_drops:
Noah: :house: — will rescue the umbrella and leave it by the kitchen table.
Marta: :thumbsup: leaving a mini clothesline in the bathroom for wet gear.
Priya: Appreciate the rescue squad. Also posting a very dramatic soggy-hoodie selfie in #random-pics in 3...2...1 :camera_with_flash:
Alex: :laughing: please do. Might be the new onboarding ritual: soggy-hoodie day.
Priya: OK uploaded. Caption: "Redwood Inference — keeping inference and hoodies optimized." :soggy_hoodie: (not a real emoji)
CommuteBot: Reminder — shuttle has limited capacity during severe weather. Consider alternate routes or staggered arrival.
Sam: PSA: if you're biking later, watch for the oil slick on 17th by Market. I almost did a cartoon slip.
Priya: Noted. Thanks everyone, see you shortly (hopefully drier).
